blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Harbour Chines rose from 6 in June to 9 in September (+50.0%), and 7 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.1% of Coquitlam’s 425 houses listed.

items.t: Harbour Chines real estate (all home types)

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Harbour Chines?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 houses listed in Harbour Chines. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Harbour Chines a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Harbour Chines had a sales ratio of 33% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Harbour Chines from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Harbour Chines over those 4 months, out of 219 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Harbour Chines?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
